wholePhysicalScope: The named OpenStreetMap precinct identifies the monument. The aerial-derived Overture roof outline records the north, east and west shrine wings and the south entrance. Fergusson’s printed measurements anchor the roof proportions and podium width.
lodDetails: Four detail levels retain the shrine wings, carved stone podium and pillared porch. Near levels resolve pilasters and eave details.
limitations: The model covers the three linked shrines, southern porch and temple podium. The separately restored Kalyana Mandapa is outside this model.
Modern vector geometry supplies the plan and the 1910 survey records exterior dimensions. Heights, projections and positions of individual carving details are approximate.
The temple exterior simplifies pierced grilles, sculpted figures, lathe-turned pillars and the eroded edges of the original stonework.
